agricidaniel-claude-blog-blog.description: Full-lifecycle blog engine with 31 sub-skills, 12 templates, 100-point scoring, and 5 agents. Routes requests to the right sub-skill: writing, rewriting, analysis, outlines, audits, schema, charts, images, repurposing, AI citation SEO, FLOW prompts, topic clusters, and multilingual publishing. Optimized for Google rankings, E-E-A-T, and AI citations. Supports any platform. Use when the user asks to create, revise, analyze, plan, translate, localize, audit, or repurpose blog content, or invokes a /blog subcommand. Do not activate merely because the word "blog" appears in an unrelated coding,…
agricidaniel-claude-blog-blog.author: AgriciDaniel

agricidaniel-claude-blog-blog-analyze.description: Score one blog post (or a folder of posts) on a 5-category 100-point scale covering content quality, SEO, E-E-A-T, technical elements, and AI citation readiness. Runs the deterministic analyzer first, then adds judgment and prioritized Critical/High/Medium/Low fixes. Advisory style diagnostics never infer authorship or affect the score. Exports markdown, JSON or table; works with MDX, markdown, HTML or a URL. Use when the user asks to analyze, score, rate or check the quality of specific posts ("analyze blog", "blog score", "check blog quality", "rate this post"). For a site-wide health check…

agricidaniel-claude-blog-blog-audio.description: Paid Gemini TTS audio for a finished blog post: summary, full read-aloud, or two-speaker dialogue, with an MP3 and an HTML5 embed. Asks for explicit consent before the first paid call. Runs only on an explicit request: /blog audio, "generate audio for this blog post", "narrate this blog post", "audio version of this post", or "podcast version of this post". Not for general speech or dictation questions.
agricidaniel-claude-blog-blog-audio.author: AgriciDaniel

agricidaniel-claude-blog-blog-audit.description: Full-site blog health assessment scanning all blog files for quality scores, orphan pages, topic cannibalization, stale content, and AI citation readiness. Runs canonical batch analysis before site-wide checks. Produces per-post scores and a prioritized action queue. Use when the user asks for a site-wide blog health check across many posts ("blog audit", "blog health", "audit all posts", "site audit of the blog"). For one post, or a quality score with fixes for a few named files, use blog-analyze instead.

agricidaniel-claude-blog-blog-brand.description: Establish durable brand and voice context for cross-skill consumption. Generates BRAND.md (audience, positioning, do/don't editorial rules, taboo phrases, competitor differentiation) and VOICE.md (existing persona JSON re-expressed as readable prose), both written to the project root. When present, the blog orchestrator loads these files, fenced as untrusted data, for write, rewrite, brief, outline, calendar, and strategy workflows. Pairs with blog-persona, which manages the structured persona JSON. Use when the user says "blog brand", "create brand context", "BRAND.md", "VOICE.md",…

agricidaniel-claude-blog-blog-brief.description: Create a content brief for ONE planned post: target and secondary keywords, search intent, template choice, competitor gaps from the live SERP, sourced statistics to include, section plan, internal-link targets, and distribution ideas. Use when the user says "content brief", "blog brief", "SEO brief", "article brief". Not a skeleton only (blog-outline), a multi-post plan (blog-strategy, blog-calendar, blog-cluster), or the article itself (blog-write).

agricidaniel-claude-blog-blog-calendar.description: Build a dated monthly or quarterly editorial calendar: which posts to publish or review when, content mix, templates, distribution timing, and a material-change review queue. Use when the user says "editorial calendar", "content calendar", "publishing schedule", "what should I write this month". Not for positioning or pillars (blog-strategy), SERP-validated cluster maps (blog-cluster), or detecting declining pages from Search Console exports (blog-decay). Publication frequency is not a ranking signal.

agricidaniel-claude-blog-blog-cannibaliz.description: Detect keyword cannibalization across blog posts by extracting primary keywords from titles and headings, clustering semantically similar targets, and flagging posts competing for the same search intent. Supports a free local mode (file analysis) and a paid DataForSEO API mode that runs only after the user approves the call count. Outputs a severity-scored report with a recommended action per cluster (merge, differentiate, canonical, noindex, or no action). Use when the user says "cannibalization", "keyword overlap", "competing pages". Not a site audit (blog-audit) or cluster planning…

agricidaniel-claude-blog-blog-chart.description: Internal capability, not user-invocable: the orchestrator calls it while running blog-write or blog-rewrite to turn research data into dark-mode compatible inline SVG charts (horizontal bar, grouped bar, donut, line, lollipop, area, radar) for HTML or MDX. Produces accessible markup (role=img, aria-labelledby, unique ids), source attribution and transparent backgrounds. Agents cannot call it.

agricidaniel-claude-blog-blog-cluster.description: Semantic topic cluster planning and automated execution engine for claude-blog. Performs SERP-based keyword research, groups keywords by search intent and SERP overlap, builds a hub-and-spoke cluster architecture, generates an interactive SVG cluster map, and executes the full cluster by orchestrating blog-write calls with shared cluster context and automatic internal-link injection. Fills the strategy-to-execution gap: blog-strategy plans the blueprint, blog-cluster builds the house. Use when user says "blog cluster", "topic cluster", "content cluster", "cluster plan", "cluster execute",…
agricidaniel-claude-blog-blog-cluster.author: AgriciDaniel

agricidaniel-claude-blog-blog-decay.description: Compare two Google Search Console page exports (current vs previous period) to flag pages whose clicks or impressions fell by a chosen threshold, with a triage hint (refresh, query shift, consolidate, prune). The 20% default is a screening heuristic, not proof of decay. Use for "/blog decay", "content decay", "QoQ decline", "refresh declining posts". Needs two GSC exports; not for diagnosing a single traffic drop live (blog-google) or rewriting posts (blog-rewrite).

agricidaniel-claude-blog-blog-discourse.description: Research what people are actually saying about a topic in the last 30 days across Reddit, X / Twitter, YouTube, Hacker News, dev.to, Medium, and other public discourse platforms. API-free; uses WebSearch with platform-targeted site operators plus recency filters. Produces DISCOURSE.md (a structured brief) and JSON output the writer can consume. Complements blog-researcher (which focuses on authority sources) with a recency-and-engagement lens. Not for verifying statistics (blog-factcheck) or gathering authority sources. Use when user says "blog discourse", "discourse research", "what are…

agricidaniel-claude-blog-blog-factcheck.description: Verify statistics and claims in blog posts by fetching cited source URLs and checking if the claimed data actually appears on the page. Extracts all load-bearing claims (statistics, product or policy claims, ranking and comparative claims, named sources), validates cited URLs before fetching, and scores match confidence (exact match 1.0, paraphrase 0.7-0.9, not found 0.0). Flags uncited claims as UNVERIFIED and marks a claim verified only when this run fetched the source and found the passage. Checks that a source says what the post says it says; it cannot prove the source is true or verify…

agricidaniel-claude-blog-blog-flow.description: FLOW framework integration for bloggers. Evidence-led content workflow using the Find, Optimize, Win loop with stage-specific AI prompts from the FLOW knowledge base (30 blog-applicable prompts, adapted from FLOW under CC BY 4.0). Use when user says "FLOW framework", "blog flow", "/blog flow", "evidence-led blogging", or "find optimize win", or asks for stage-specific blog prompts. Not for generic prompt writing.
agricidaniel-claude-blog-blog-flow.author: AgriciDaniel

agricidaniel-claude-blog-blog-geo.description: Audit one blog post file for AI-citation readiness (self-contained, sourced passages, entity clarity, structure, crawler access) and score it with an internal 0-100 heuristic plus per-surface notes for AI Overviews, AI Mode, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, and Copilot. Use when the user says "geo", "aeo", "ai citation", "citation audit", "chatgpt citation". Not for a site-wide audit, live AI-visibility tracking, or schema generation (use claude-seo seo-geo, blog-audit, blog-schema), and not a promise of citations.

agricidaniel-claude-blog-blog-google.description: Credentialed Google API calls for a blog: PageSpeed Insights, CrUX history, Search Console performance and URL Inspection, GA4 organic traffic, Cloud NLP entities, YouTube video search, Google Ads Keyword Planner, and the Indexing API (job and livestream pages only). Uses the user's Google credentials, quotas, and sometimes billing, and asks for consent before the first call. Runs only on an explicit request: /blog google, "run PageSpeed on this blog URL", "pull my Search Console data", "inspect this URL's index status", "set up Google API credentials". Shares config with claude-seo at…
agricidaniel-claude-blog-blog-google.author: AgriciDaniel

agricidaniel-claude-blog-blog-image.description: Paid Gemini image generation for blog heroes, inline illustrations, and OG cards (direct API by default, optional MCP for edits). Asks for explicit consent before the first paid call. Runs only on an explicit request: /blog image, "generate a blog hero image", "blog illustration", "edit this blog image", "OG image", or when blog-write or blog-rewrite needs a hero. Not for charts (blog-chart) or stock-photo search.
agricidaniel-claude-blog-blog-image.author: AgriciDaniel

agricidaniel-claude-blog-blog-locale-aud.description: Read-only audit of a folder of existing multilingual blog posts: translation coverage, parity, hreflang and canonical consistency, meta-tag parity, and stale translations, with a prioritized report. Use when the user says "locale audit", "check translations", "multilingual audit", "hreflang check", "Uebersetzungen pruefen" about posts that already exist. Not for creating or fixing translations (blog-translate, blog-localize, blog-multilingual) or for a site-wide technical hreflang crawl (claude-seo seo-hreflang).
agricidaniel-claude-blog-blog-locale-aud.author: AgriciDaniel

agricidaniel-claude-blog-blog-localize.description: Deep cultural adaptation of an already translated blog post for one target market: local examples, CTAs, legal references, statistic sources, and formality (Sie/du, tu/vous). Built-in profiles for DACH, Francophone, Hispanic, and Japanese markets. Use when the user says "localize blog", "cultural adaptation", "adapt for Germany", "lokalisieren", "localiser", "adaptar" and a translation already exists. Not for translating (use blog-translate), auditing a folder of translations (use blog-locale-audit), or the full write-translate-localize pipeline (use blog-multilingual).
agricidaniel-claude-blog-blog-localize.author: AgriciDaniel

agricidaniel-claude-blog-blog-multilingu.description: One-command multilingual blog creation. Writes a blog post, translates it into user-specified languages, applies cultural adaptation, and emits hreflang tags, sitemap entries, and a CMS-ready language map. The complete write-to-publish pipeline for international content. Orchestrates blog-write, blog-translate, blog-localize, and (optionally) seo-hreflang. Use when user says "multilingual blog", "blog multilingual", "write in multiple languages", "international blog", "mehrsprachiger Blog", "blog multilingue", "blog multilingue", "create blog in German and French".
agricidaniel-claude-blog-blog-multilingu.author: AgriciDaniel

agricidaniel-claude-blog-blog-notebooklm.description: Query a user's Gemini Notebook (formerly NotebookLM) for source-grounded answers through a logged-in browser session on their Google account. Uses the account's usage limits and writes browser state. Runs only on an explicit request: /blog notebooklm, "ask my Gemini Notebook", "ask my NotebookLM notebook", or "query my notebook library". Also used by blog-write when the user named a notebook for research. Not for generic research or note-taking.
agricidaniel-claude-blog-blog-notebooklm.author: AgriciDaniel

agricidaniel-claude-blog-blog-outline.description: SERP-informed outline generation with H2/H3 heading hierarchy, competitive content gap analysis, section-by-section word count targets, chart and image placement markers, optional FAQ question planning, and internal linking zones. Skeleton only: structure, H2/H3 hierarchy, word counts, optional FAQ slots. Use blog-brief instead if you need full competitive analysis, statistics research, and image suggestions. Lighter than a full content brief, generates article skeleton and structure only, ready for /blog write to consume. Use when user says "outline", "blog outline", "content outline",…

agricidaniel-claude-blog-blog-persona.description: Create and manage writing personas with NNGroup 4-dimension tone framework (Funny-Serious, Formal-Casual, Respectful-Irreverent, Enthusiastic-Matter-of-fact). Personas define readability targets, sentence length distribution, vocabulary tier, contraction frequency, and summary box label. blog-write and blog-rewrite load the active persona as writer guidance. Use when the user says "create persona", "use persona", "list personas", or wants tone sliders and writing rules saved as structured JSON. Not for measuring style from existing posts (blog-style) or for audience, positioning, and…

agricidaniel-claude-blog-blog-repurpose.description: Turn an existing blog post into draft text for other channels: X threads, LinkedIn posts, Threads/Bluesky, short-video scripts, YouTube scripts, Reddit posts, newsletter excerpts, podcast scripts. Saves drafts to files; it never posts anywhere. Never invents personal stories or results: first-hand framing appears only when the user supplies it. Use when the user says "repurpose", "turn this post into a thread", "linkedin post from blog", "youtube script from post". Not for writing the blog post itself (blog-write) or scheduling.

agricidaniel-claude-blog-blog-rewrite.description: Rewrite and optimize existing blog posts for Google SEO (E-E-A-T, helpful content) and AI citation visibility as one SEO discipline. For AI-citation-only audit (no Google work), use blog-geo instead. Replaces fabricated statistics with sourced data, applies answer-first formatting, adds images, generates SVG charts, and updates modified dates only for substantive changes. Works with any blog format (MDX, markdown, HTML). Use when user says "rewrite blog", "optimize blog", "update blog", "improve blog", "fix blog".

agricidaniel-claude-blog-blog-schema.description: Generate JSON-LD for ONE blog post (BlogPosting with Person, Organization, BreadcrumbList, ImageObject, VideoObject; FAQPage only as optional entity markup) in a single @graph, and check it against Google's current structured data support. Use when the user says "generate schema", "json-ld for this post", "blog schema". Not for auditing schema across a whole site or other schema types (claude-seo seo-schema), not for product pages, and not a promise of rich results: FAQ rich results ended 2026-05-07.

agricidaniel-claude-blog-blog-seo-check.description: Post-writing SEO validation with pass/fail checklist covering title tag clarity and uniqueness, meta description quality, heading hierarchy, internal/external link audit with anchor text analysis, canonical URL verification, Open Graph meta tags (og:title, og:description, og:image), Twitter Card validation, structured data presence and validity, URL structure optimization, and image alt text presence. Produces prioritized fix list with specific recommendations. Use for ONE finished post when the user says "seo check", "validate seo", "on-page seo", "title tag check", "link audit". Not for a…

agricidaniel-claude-blog-blog-strategy.description: Build a blog-level strategy for a niche or business: audience segments, 3-5 content pillars with hub-and-spoke clusters, competitive gaps, measurement plan, and a 90-day roadmap. Use when the user says "blog strategy", "content strategy", "blog positioning", "content pillars", "what should I blog about". Not for a dated publishing schedule (blog-calendar), SERP-validated cluster maps (blog-cluster), or a brief or outline for one post (blog-brief, blog-outline). Makes no promise of rankings or AI citations.

agricidaniel-claude-blog-blog-style.description: Measure writing-style statistics (sentence length, vocabulary, transitions, phrasing) from 5 to 10 posts you or your client wrote, and produce a voice profile for VOICE.md, blog-persona, and blog-write. Use for "learn my style", "build a writing baseline". It describes style; it does not detect or attribute authorship, and it is not for scoring a post (blog-analyze) or writing brand rules (blog-brand).

agricidaniel-claude-blog-blog-taxonomy.description: Suggest tags and categories for a blog post from its content, audit a site's tag and category health, and, only after the user approves a shown plan, sync tags and categories to WordPress, Shopify, Ghost, Strapi, or Sanity. suggest and audit are read-only; sync is dry-run by default and never deletes, merges, or edits post content. Use when the user says "tag suggestions", "taxonomy audit", "sync tags", "WordPress tags", "Shopify tags". Not for keyword research (blog-brief) or schema markup (blog-schema).

agricidaniel-claude-blog-blog-translate.description: Translate existing blog posts into one or more target languages with SEO-optimized localization. Produces native-quality translations that preserve markdown structure, frontmatter, schema JSON-LD, image and chart embeds, and evidence-backed explanations. Localizes keywords, meta tags, numbers, dates, currencies, and quote styles per locale. Flags machine-translation artifacts for review. Run BEFORE blog-localize: this handles language conversion; localize handles cultural adaptation after translation completes. Use when user says "translate blog", "blog translate", "uebersetzen", "traduire",…
agricidaniel-claude-blog-blog-translate.author: AgriciDaniel

agricidaniel-claude-blog-blog-write.description: Write a new blog article from scratch for Google rankings and AI citations, then take it through the delivery gates. Generates the full article with template selection, answer-first formatting, Key Takeaways box, sourced statistics, licensed images, built-in SVG charts, optional FAQ and internal linking, in MDX, markdown or HTML. Use when the user asks to write a new blog post or article from a topic or brief ("write a blog post", "draft a new article", "/blog write"). Not for editing an existing post (blog-rewrite), and not for a standalone outline, brief or research request.

agricidaniel-claude-blog-brain.description: Scaffold and operate Claude Blog Brain, a source-cited Obsidian brain for blog content creation, optimization, and management dual-optimized for Google rankings (E-E-A-T, the 2026 core updates) and AI citations (GEO/AEO), spanning writing, rewriting and freshness, SERP-informed briefs and outlines, editorial calendars and strategy, semantic topic clusters, schema and internal linking, multilingual publishing, the FLOW framework, factchecking, personas, distribution, and the blog delivery contract, grounded in the claude-blog skill. Use when the user says "claude-blog-brain", "Claude Blog…
